summary: Skip aliases exclude platforms (skip/freebsd, skip/macos, skip/rhel, skip/docker), specific versions (skip/rhel7.6, skip/windows/2019) or Python majors; use when conditionals for finer control.
questions: How do I skip an integration test on macOS?
How do I skip a test on a specific Windows Server version?

answer_card.title: Skip aliases
answer_card.answer_md:
- Platforms: `skip/freebsd`, `skip/macos`, `skip/rhel`, `skip/docker`
- Versions (from `--remote`, no `/`): `skip/rhel7.6`, `skip/freebsd11.1`
- Windows: `skip/windows/2016`, `/2019`, `/2022`
- Python: `skip/python2`, `skip/python3`

For finer control use `when:` in the test playbook.
